_comment: Feedback v1 (docs/feedback_loop_design.md): starved-advancement test. Node b is consumed ONLY by tap edges (its own self-tap and a's tap), so the pull never ticks it - it must ride the advance list or this renders silence. b self-counts by 0.02/tick to the 8.0 guard ceiling; a reads b through a tap; output scales a to 0.1. A dead advance list = all-zero WAV.
